usage: The word '病人' refers to a person who is receiving medical treatment.
'病人' can be used to talk about patients in hospitals, clinics, or any medical setting.
When speaking about a specific patient, you can use '呢個病人' (this patient) or '嗰個病人' (that patient).
In conversations, '病人' can be used without any classifier in general terms or with classifiers like '位' when counting patients.
It is a noun, so it can be used as a subject or object in sentences.
